Ports the gRPC/shared-metrics slice of [#20675](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20675), excluding Thrift and Dubbo. Applies to RPC preview telemetry, including duplicate mode:

```properties
otel.semconv-stability.preview=rpc/dup
```

- **gRPC:** Use bounded status-code names for all non-OK client statuses and existing server-error statuses. Leave cancellation-only server calls without `error.type`; preserve throwable fallback, span status, exception events, and legacy telemetry.
- **Metrics:** Add `error.type` to attribute advice only for `rpc.client.call.duration` and `rpc.server.call.duration`.
- **Coverage:** Extend unary, streaming-error, cancellation, and duration assertions; update shared metrics tests and affected Sofa RPC assertions.
metadata.title: Classify terminal gRPC errors in RPC preview telemetry
